purpose: Company values, presented as a zig-zag threaded list on desktop.

responsive.desktop: alternating self-end/self-start columns with per-card negative margin-top, threaded by a static 6846px SVG zig-zag that scroll-draws blue over an oat base — see src/pages/AboutUs.jsx:185-236 for exact per-card margins.

mobile.change: stagger and zig-zag line both collapse — cards center-align in a plain flex column, gap 16px, margin-top 0.

motion.pattern: line-draw scroll-linked stroke-dasharray + fd-fade per card
motion.reducedMotionFallback: static full-length lines, cards at rest opacity
